mapper.update: UPDATE sys_module SET path = CONCAT(#{newPath}, SUBSTRING(path, #{oldPathLength} + 1)) WHERE path LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPath}, '/%')
mapper.select: select distinct m.* from SYS_MODULE M, SYS_ROLE R, SYS_ROLE_MODULE RM, SYS_ROLEUSER_REF RU where M.STATUS != '0001' and R.ID=RM.ROLE_ID and M.ID=RM.MODULE_ID and R.ID=RU.ROLE_ID and ru.USER_ID = #{userId} order by m.orders asc

select * from v_granted_module m
and role_Code in
#{code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (m.parent_Id = '0' or m.parent_Id is null)
and m.name like
concat('%',#{condition,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%' ||#{condition}||'%'
and m.status = #{module.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and m.name like
concat('%',#{module.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%'||#{module.name}||'%'
order by id asc

select SM.*, SMR.ID R_ID, SMR.MODULE_ID, SMR.RESOURCE_DESC, SMR.RESOURCE_URL, SMR.RESOURCE_TYPE from SYS_MODULE SM LEFT JOIN SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES SMR ON SM.ID = SMR.MODULE_ID
and (parent_id is null or parent_id = '0')
and parent_id = #{module.parent_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and status in(#{module.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'9999')
and name like
concat('%',#{module.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%'||#{module.name}||'%'
order by orders asc

select SM.*, SMR.ID R_ID, SMR.MODULE_ID, SMR.RESOURCE_DESC, SMR.RESOURCE_URL, SMR.RESOURCE_TYPE from sys_module SM LEFT JOIN SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES SMR ON SM.ID = SMR.MODULE_ID where parent_ID = #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by orders asc
select * from sys_module module where module.id = (select parent_Id from sys_module og where og.id = #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) order by orders asc

select
ifnull(max(orders),0)
nvl(max(orders),0)
from sys_module where
parent_ID is null
parent_ID = #{pid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT m.ID , m.NAME, m.PID, m.PATH, m.ISLEAF, m.CODE, m.SORT FROM SYS_ROLEUSER_REF ru JOIN SYS_ROLERES_REF rr ON ru.ROLE_ID = rr.ROLE_ID JOIN SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES r ON rr.RESOURCE_ID = r.ID JOIN SYS_MODULE m ON r.MODULE_ID = m.ID WHERE ru.USER_ID = #{uid} AND
ORDER BY m.SORT ASC;
mapper.update:
update sys_module set PARENT_NAME=#{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where parent_id like
concat(#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
#{id}||'%'

update sys_module set PATH_NAME=REPLACE(PARENT_NAME,#{oldModule.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{newModule.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), PATH=REPLACE(PATH,#{oldModule.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{newModule.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) where path like
concat('%',#{oldModule.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%'||#{oldModule.path}||'%'
and id != #{oldModule.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
